summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 5 new features: (1) B2B bulk shipping rules - professional <150€ charges total weight, ≥150€ with bulk charges only bulk weight, retail unchanged; (2) Mobile /tienda product cards reordered to category+name → stars → description → image → formats → buttons (desktop unchanged); (3) Product detail 'Explora más categorías' now collapsible (closed by default); (4) New mobile bottom nav with 5 controls (Menu, Home, Account center raised, Wishlist, Cart), person/cart icons removed from mobile header; (5) Cart drawer recommendation section renamed to 'Explorar más productos'. All backend API tests (23/23) and frontend UI tests passed successfully.
